_comment: The front door's numbers (docs/design/front-door.md, section 3; web/pages/index.html). card_min_px is the narrowest an update card may be before the row drops a card, chosen by the measurement in section 3 (the last 100 release headlines in the card's own font: at 220 px with five lines none is cut). As many cards as fit at card_min_px, at most card_max; below two side by side, a swipe row of card_max cards each swipe_card_px wide (at most 82% of the row). updates_url is the server's release feed (src/relay/front_door.rs); refresh_after_ms is how long a tab must have been away before the page asks it again, never on a timer. No chat slice: the operator, 2026-11-02, "Let's exclude it from the front page."
